claim: The sample opens with three records, uses separate storage, resets, and never changes the normal inventory.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real record; enter /demo; change and reset sample; return to real inventory; inspect both IndexedDB stores

claim: The demo reloads and exports a CSV offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; load /demo; wait for service-worker control; set the context offline; reload and export

claim: Records stay in the browser, with no account, analytics, tracking, CDN, or cloud inventory request.
where: landing facts, privacy page, footer, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; edit and reload a record; record every request origin; check that no account control exists

claim: CSV export has one row per record and every saved text field.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download CSV; assert header fields, sample values, and exact row count

claim: The inventory stores item details, photos, receipts, and locations, shows missing evidence, persists after reload, and supports search.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; add a complete item with photo and receipt; reload; verify its fields and completeness; search by serial number

claim: JSON export carries every record, photo, and receipt attachment.
where: landing, export page, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download JSON; parse it and assert three records plus named binary attachment data

claim: Encrypted backups carry records and attachments, reject a wrong passphrase, never store it, and use PBKDF2-SHA-256 with 250,000 iterations plus AES-256-GCM with random salt and IV.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; compare two exports; inspect algorithms and byte lengths; inspect storage; test failed retry state; import on a second profile

claim: The free PDF export has an item index, evidence details, locations, one item page per record, and a photo when present.
sandbox: fresh /demo context without a license or payment; download PDF; inspect signature, page tree, embedded image, and size

claim: A 50-item encrypted export opens in another browser profile without an account in under ten minutes.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; add records through the UI to reach 50; encrypt; import into a second browser context; assert count and elapsed time

claim: A removed item can be restored immediately with Undo.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; confirm removal; assert count drops; activate Undo; assert count returns
